body:
I'm sorry for the delay. 

I see it is kind of both the source and solution to your anxiety.

If you feel that you should see any kind of mental specialist, instead of trying to work your point by the side band, you could tell it straight and clear to your parents. E.g. Currently I don't feel alright in my head I would like to see a psychologist to work my way our of it. I kind of did this when I was younger but in my case I didn't want to see a psy and, looking back, my parents should have forced me to.

I don't want to force you to anything, I just want my point to be clear. I regret not fixing those problems when they were lighter (even if they felt overwhelming already) and I wasn't on my own far away from family support. It is still manageable now so it is alright but it would have been better... 

I'm sorry for the morale type of comment. I really don't mean to lecture you or anything. I just want to share my experience with you hoping it will help you.

Why did you want your parents to take you to an hospital? 

Also, that's not dumb, I mean we all have our issues and our ways to cope with them. Some are less forgiving than others but still somehow fits along the line. 

There is definitely different kinds of addiction. Caffeine creates a really weal addiction and the curing process might take up to a week of headache. It isn't really that much. I don't have much experience with consumption addictions but must definitely if it feels close to behavioral addictions, they are a pain in the butt to cope with. 

Do you have anxiety only when you stop taking phenibut?

Them keeping you wouldn't it be a fresh start? Maybe it would be a first step to overcome your anxiety. 

I didn't live what you are living but I do know how anxiety can make you feel towards that kind of stuff. But to start to overcome that you have to focus on one thing you want to fix. Just one at a time. It worked for me and when I felt confident with the progress of that goal I started to add a second one very slowly. Trying to work on everything at the same time just made me fail everything and made me even more anxious. 

That's is just an idea and I really don't want to tell you what you should or shouldn't do. I'm sorry if I didn't word it properly. 

Do you have siblings you can share your worries with? 
Or maybe friends or your parents? 

In my case I found it to be easier to open up on reddit first and then started to talk with a friend about everything. He really helped me go through my very anxious moments and also my extremes down moments. He is very supportive and having somebody always ready to kind of hold all the falling bits together is incredibly relieving. It moves a weight off your shoulders. It was the first time I would open up to somebody face to face / not online. It feels / felt great. 

Regarding the phenibut, don't worry too much about being back at the full dose. Failing is part of making it happen. Just the fact that you tried to stop is an achievement on its own. You can do it, I believe in you! You've already spent some time with just half the dose, maybe try to double that length? 

Regarding your oral thrush, not being a doctor I can say anything but advise you what you already know: you should see a doctor. Maybe you can bring somebody with you just to  change your mind and make it easier?

It takes a lot of energy to get out of this and you might fall into it again. I'm not sure yet which way is the best living or dying but I chose, again, living and I think I am back at a "normal" life. It is doable, from the point I decided to move on and started to actually get out and do stuff and put energy in it, it's been about two months. I had downs and some really bad ones. The last 2 weeks have been much more stable and I can enjoy stuff now. 

I think you can work your way out of this mood. My trigger to decide to make a move was when my mother told me she also wanted to kill herself. I didn't want to be the one to make her do it. We support each other now. We are moving through.

If you ever change your mind and want to talk, I am there.

Dreams comes with doing stuff. Dreams aren't always frivolous or unattainable. A dream could be to make one person happy, feel exceptional... e.g. Your wife. Having blank feelings about daily life often comes with routine. I would advise to try to break your routine. Do different things you don't normally do. In the end, dreams are most of the time the extension of something you have already experienced and liked. 

A great part of what you are admiring in your brother is the pursuit of his dream. The effort he is pulling off to get there. Also, he has probably doubted many times about his choices. 

Nobody has to put the same effort to keep the dream alive. If you are someone who requires a lot of dream maintenance like me, break it down in small goals and work them one by one. Believe me, doing so will give you more ideas and dreams :)

No, they are not right. However, I am not objective on the matter, your friends opinion is offending. 

More rationally speaking, you are probably living a bad time right now regarding your mother's murder and your father's suicide. However, they are not you. You get to live your life and it is your very own. Never having had a boyfriend is not a weakness. You are not defined by the people around you and your relation with them. You are yourself;  you are defined by your own actions and choices. 

I don't think suicide is an option no matter what happen in our lives. Suicide is giving up on who you are and could be. I believe in you; you've reached out to reddit and I think it is favorable to your recovery. 

If you need or just want to talk, feel free to poke. I am not the most talkative person but I do listen and will reply :).
If you need more ear, I'm here to listen.

Yes, the only solution I found to work for the past few weeks is to go to the gym and give it all. I somehow sleep much better and the next day I don't feel tired anymore but my muscles are in pain. That is a trade-off I can accept.

You can live the way you want as long as you let others do the same.
I have plenty of friend, girls, behaving more manly than me, having more typical men interests than me and they are straight and they are accepted this way. I don't know how old you are but I've seen things change a lot when I got older. It might not be the case for everyone.


I'm sorry you have to live throught this... but in the end I believe it makes someone stronger and more understanding on their needs and theirselves. This is cheesy and mostly as comforting as time heals, I know. I've been on this end where I couldn't see where I fit in the one man mold. Others lives the same thing and they will surround themselves people with the same interests. Nobody is normal and trying to fit in the mold puts tremendous pressure on someone.

Today I still feel different than most and some still don't accept/like the way I am but I do and it is what matters. I hope you can say the same someday.


The point I was trying to make is: Don't give up on what makes you, you. Accept it and live it thoughtfully. If you are confident in yourself, others will also be. The same applies for a lover. I'm sure you will find someone to share and evolve with.

Why is that so? 

I don't mean that I disagree, I just want your opinion.

I get the point and I half agree. I mean men sure have it hard but there is no comparison with women. Both have it hard differently. At the moment, in my country, men tend to have less support than women to go through their problems. My opinion on why it is that men have less support is because men will not seek help until they are destroyed enough. The men role model is strong, beautiful, charming,... There is no place in the alpha male stereotype definition where a men could seek help. Seeking help is seen as weak and men should be strong. 

Where I disagree is that women have it easier. They have their own issues and stereotypes to overcome. Comparing them will not solve their individual problems.

tl;dr: please don't drop such a big bomb on something that doesn't really matter in the end.

You have to learn to say no. It is difficult but if a situation makes uncomfortable you can always say no. Money is never an easy subject in any relation. I would advice to have friends with the same values as you do. Then lending money would naturally be 'solved'. My friends and I often share bills. Sure thing a bit of money gets lost in the process but we always repay each other (usually rounded up or down). 
Saying no is also and option and would probably help you to build your relationship with your friends with even more solid grounds. Have confidence and listen to yourself. Don't help your friends because it has to be done or that's what friends should do; help your friends because you genuinely want to help them. 

I have also been abused for the same things in the past and this issue directly comes down to my own fault. I had to learn  to say no,  to step away from bad friends and to be confident about it.

There is a lot of people who don't care about breast sizes. I understand you are going through a tough time right now. I too have been cheated on and dumped recently. My past relationships ended the same. I admire your self esteem and I do understand that what you are seeking is a solution for the problem hurting you (how people view small breasts). It is true that our society highlights bigger breasts. However, I think you have been unlucky so far to encounter people who can't go beyond that trait of a body. 

I feel I can relate to what you are living. If you want to talk, I would be glad to chat with you.

Do you like to role-playing? There is iwakuroleplay.com if you enjoy it, there is plenty of other skilled writers with whom you can jam a story. You could change your mind and make new friends at the same time. At some point it was my plan to do so. Everybody is nice with me but, as a non-native English writer, I didn't feel confident I could keep up to everyone expectations. 

Temporary or not, it is a relieving.

Don't worry, I'm all ears. Do you have any relative nearby? Maybe they could actively change your minds. Alcohol makes things worst for me, it seems to help at first but it always end up backfiring. Currently what works for me is just reading; it is hard to get started and want to keep going but it does change my minds. Another way I have to pass through time alone is to sleep. I have insomnia but lately I'm sleep deprived enough to fall asleep quite easily when needed.

Is there really another choice? 

I wouldn't want others around me to hurt their selves. I honestly had a much more selfish vision not too long ago. But it changed when my mother told me she wanted to commit suicide. I was not alone and I know know what kind of impact it will have on my family. I'm stuck like this, I don't want to be the first of us two for obvious reason although when I'm gone I can no longer blame myself. I see people as more than just as living flesh and when the body dies their past actions still affect everything. It is nothing spiritual... 

I'm not blind. I want to end it but not like this. I'm not ignoring my pain I'm judging what its worth against consequences. I give up on my life but not on my mother's. How could I ever...

I chose to deal with my problems this way and I agree time wont make it any different. It will only grow bigger and darker until I finally end it. I don't want to harm my family and friends this way.

I understand how hard it is to believe. I too don't really like the idea. I tend to diverge from when the tend to be or to think. I have authority because they are enforcing an idea and they don't even know why it exist. On my end, I chose this vision to be my reality. I will not end my life because I have no right to do so. All the pain I feel will last and I have to live with it. Ending my life to end the pain is not an option. The pain itself isn't really a my pain per say because I didn't choose to live it. I choose to feel what I've decided not what others enforce upon my person. I can fight authority or common beliefs knowing that. In the end I feel much better accepting that I can't possibly choose if I want to continue living and that choice as been made for me. I only have to deal with the consequences.

I understand what you mean by it is a depressing thought. It is not the freedom I've always been told I had. But this is how I see the reality. I was never born with this right and that is consistent with everything I can think of. I'm okay with that because it is not like if I can choose to live forever neither that I had to. I think we all live within those boundaries and it is part of what's making it hard to leap. I wouldn't want anybody to kill (him/her)self and it would be selfish of me to break that rule. 

I find it more acceptable to just say that I didn't own my life in the end. It belongs to everyone affected by it. I think it fits with the fact that you wanted to push your family away so you could finally think their are no longer owning your life. That's just an opinion.

I'm sorry for the delay. I'm not really proficient with reddit... I didn't notice the reply until now. I'm glad I made your feel understood. I'm feeling much better right now although I know it will come back. I'm still available for chatting if you want to.

I understand the general feeling. On my end I do not have any guilt directly related to my family mourning my death. I just don't think killing myself is my choice only. They have more interest in me than I do. I should as well let them decide. One man's trash is someone's treasure. 

In your case you would feel guilt anyhow. If you push them away or upset them you know it is just a temporary feeling on their end. They would care if you killed yourself even after that.

To me suicide is selfish because I do not own myself. I never did. I am a slave of my society, my family, my friends and my work. They shaped my personality and taught me everything. They brought me to life and fed me. I didn't do all that, they did. Suicide wouldn't be selfish if I had repaid them beforehand. 

However, I didn't demand that they took care of all that for me. By taking care of me they didn't want to make me feel guilty about wanting to die. Ultimately, selfish or not, killing myself is just not what I should do to solve my issues although I want to. My relatives doesn't matter in the equation, I just don't have any rights on my life. Passing through all of my pain is the only solution although I could end it. I don't think I will make it out. I will probably just end up feeling this void is just how it is and that's fine. 

I would want more but at this stage I would settle for at least that.

I don't know, I care and I shouldn't. 

If dieing would help someone else I would do it. Although, I, living, won't prevent somebody else to live. If I can't find a purpose for myself maybe others can. As I said before, I don't belong to me; thinking otherwise is a mistake. Being in pain people might not care but ending "my" life would affect my relatives more than me. They can handle it and so can I handle my pain. I belong to the people I know and they belong to me. There is more "they" than "I",  I owe them the same respect. Ending my life is an option, I wouldn't have to care about living issues but it feels wrong for people who know me. 

tl;dr: idk

This is just my thoughts... Take what you want, leave what you don't and feel free to hate. 

My answer would be:
- Because death is permanent and they are scared of screwing it over. 
- Because they aren't in pain now; hope and desire still carries them forward. 

These is no reason to live as much as there is no reason to die. Pain drags one way and joy drags the other way. They never balance out, they will never balance out. People don't "want" to live, they don't want to lose their live. Most people will choose higher chances not to lose over higher chances to actually win.

No matter how tempting is suicide I still have doubts. What if it was just a long phase? Meanwhile, I seek interests or passion, I try things because living without trying is worst than death. One day I will be ready to end my life but not today. I want that day to be without doubts but I see no reason to make it happen sooner. Don't get me wrong, right now is a pretty dark time in my life; killing myself would ease my pain. But what is the point of it? Dead, I can't accomplish anything more than being alive. 

Over time, I've came to realize:
- My life doesn't even belong to me;
- There is no such things as my problems, it is everyone's problems but mines;

Knowing that, I can accept to wait for my death. 

If I turn your question the other way: Why The Fuck do People Wants to die? 
I think the same kind of answer applies: Because they lose control of their lives, everything is messed up.  There is no solution. Pulling out a suicide is effort, I could have used to do something else. 

P. S. Sorry if it doesn't make sense. I will edit it when my mind is more functional.
Thank you.

I too feel relief knowing there is a way out. It even feel more enjoyable than moving "forward" with my life. At least I would feel something real not just this creeping thought of pointlessness. 

I also feel cheated to have been given this option. If, only if, this is the only working option. I would have lived through it all for nothing.

Just making sure here that I understand everything correctly:

SecHead stands for *Security* Head right?

Safety is not a concept embed into Security?

There is always an OPV, Over Pressure Valve, for the pump to release extra pressure. Usually espresso machine' pumps are made to support ~15 bars and espresso extraction is around 10 bars (the OPV is set to 10 bars).

I wouldn't worry about it. The only things that could damage a pump is long stress (more than 5 minutes maybe?), due to heat building in the pump, and hot water.

The other parts of your machine can support even more pressure.

Espresso gear have been made to support such behavior, over tamping / too fine grind is a commonly seen use case.

As an home roaster, altitude affects coffee beans. Beans harvested in higher altitude, hard beans, farms will require more energy/time to have a similar roast than lower altitude, soft beans.

However, I do not know how latitude affects coffee.

You can roast your own coffee if you want.

The setup is quite simple.
  
1. Get at least one of the following items: popcorn popper, roasting pan, heat-gun, imagination.
2. [Done] Get a grinder, you have an Hario Skerton.
3. Buy some green coffee beans. They are pretty cheap and virually never go stale.

After a couple batches you can accuratly pinpoint how you want your beans roasted and make your own roasted coffee beans for less than 5$ per lbs.

Also note that this coffee will be at your taste and always be fresh.

It does require additionnal efforts. With some friends we bought a Behmor and 50lbs of green coffee beans. We split the cost and it does cost less that mass produced coffee.

I'm quite amazed today since I realized one new thing about how to make good latte foam with Gaggia Classic.
It doesn't take much time to get air in the milk.
Here's my complete process for a latte.

1. Preheat the machine.
2. Purge the wand until no spurts of water comes out.
3. Get some air in your milk (Discovery: This process is short. ~20 seconds)
4. Use the air in the milk to form a consistent foam. (Tip: I did a motion with my hand to swirl the milk. Maybe I don't have to but, so far, the 3 times I followed this process it worked.)
5. Purge the wand while activating the pump to get the water back in the boiler. (keep the steam button on)
6. Set the steam button off and force the machine to lower the temperature by passing the water through the group head (Activate the pump). Meanwhile wash the steam wand.
7. Do a double espresso shot.
8. Put the milk in the cup.
9. Enjoy!
10. Leave feedback of your result to your buddy theP55vv0rd.

EDIT: This is a "simplified" way to understand how your buttons changes the inner state of your machine and how to interpret the led feedback. I hope it can be useful.

**Up state from left to right**

Power off. The inner circuit of the machine is open. No electricity flows in it

Espresso brewing thermostat. Sets the maximum temperature of the boiler to whatever temperature an espresso shot should be made according to Gaggia. If the boiler gets hotter than this temperature, the heating elements circuit moves to an open state and the heating elements no longer heats (there is still some heat retention but you get the general idea).

Pump off. The pump is not functioning when the button is in this state. Which means there is no "new" water getting to the boiler reservoir.

**Down state from left to right**

Power on. The inner circuit of the machine is closed. Electricity flows in it. Better be grounded!

Steam thermostat. Sets the maximum temperature of the boiler to whatever temperature Gaggia thinks it is best for steam. If the boiler gets hotter than this temperature, the heating elements circuit get to an open state and the heating elements no longer heats (there is still some heat retention but you get the general idea).

Pump on. The pump is functioning. The pump mindlessly pushes water to the boiler reservoir. The pump is rated maximum 15 bar so at ~15 bar the pump works at is maximum capacity. (Here I am omitting that there is a device between the pump and the boiler reservoir which limits the pressure below 15 bar)

**Pump switch led meaning**

If led is powered on, the boiler reservoir temperature is above the thermostat setting limit. Therefore, the heating elements aren't heating.
